selection: First 400 eligible new source documents in the pinned shard, excluding all previously used source lines, body/full-body hashes, 192-token body-prefix hashes, and source URLs.
long_selection: First 64 of these 400 documents; a paired length variant, not additional independent samples.
model_selection: Freeze full attention readout and threshold on validation before preparing or evaluating this set.
controls: Published residual MLP-64 with its already-frozen validation threshold, evaluated on exactly the same new inputs.
protocol: Match original native C4 single/multi inputs, normal system tags, five roles, all content tokens scored. Long body cap 1024.
sample_units: Original source document; 2000 paired document-bootstrap replicates per profile.
not_claimed: No new independent natural conversations or domain-generalization guarantee. Exact/prefix/URL exclusion is not semantic near-duplicate or domain exclusion.
working_target: Report per-profile precision, recall, F1, balanced accuracy, false-positive rate and five-role accuracy; do not promote by negative-only accuracy.
plots: 12 document IDs at fixed equally spaced indices; no score-based example selection.
